steps.title: Whistle, no foul
steps.body: A ==violation== is a rules mistake that doesn't involve hitting anyone. No free throws: the other team just ==gets the ball==.

steps.title: Traveling
steps.body: Once you stop dribbling you get ==two steps==. Take a third, or lift your pivot foot before you pass or shoot, and it's traveling.
steps.note: Refs and fans argue about this one constantly.

steps.title: Double dribble
steps.body: Dribble, pick the ball up, then start dribbling again: ==double dribble==. Dribbling with ==both hands at once== counts too.

steps.title: Three seconds
steps.body: An offensive player can't stand in ==the lane==, the painted area under the hoop, for more than ==3 seconds== in a row.

steps.title: Backcourt
steps.body: The offense has ==8 seconds== to get the ball past half court. Once it's over, it ==can't go back== to the other half.

steps.title: Goaltending
steps.body: You can't block a shot that's ==on its way down== toward the hoop or already touching the rim. If you do, ==the basket counts anyway==.

steps.explain: He picked up his dribble, then took three steps. Two is the limit, so that's traveling.

steps.prompt: A defender swats a shot that was already coming down toward the hoop. What happens?
steps.explain: That's goaltending. The shooter's team gets the points as if the shot went in.
